title: NGO Development Project Funding — October 2026 cycle
description: AGFUND mid-October 2026 funding cycle (Board decision December, approved projects announced mid-January). Open to NGOs with 3+ years of history and audited financial statements, working in humanitarian, social, educational, medical, scientific, civil and technical fields across the Arab region and developing countries. NOTE: 'mid-October' is AGFUND's published recurring cutoff — confirm the exact day on agfund.org before relying on it.
